sources.entry: Claude Overlay by shengyanlin - A frameless, always-on-top floating chat window for Claude Code on Windows. It captures every monitor and lets Claude read the screen to answer questions in context, and drives the user's existing claude CLI login through the Agent SDK, with image paste, model switching, live streaming, and a context-usage statusline.

summary.one_liner: A frameless, always-on-top Windows chat window for Claude Code that captures every monitor so Claude can read the screen and answer in context, using your existing claude CLI login.
summary.what_it_does: Claude Overlay is a Tkinter floating chat window that sits over other apps and auto-captures each monitor (via Pillow ImageGrab) on every message, labeling primary and secondary screens so Claude can read them with its Read tool. It drives the user's installed claude CLI through claude-agent-sdk, so it uses an existing Claude subscription rather than an API key. The README describes image paste (Ctrl+V), attaching PDF, Word and PowerPoint files, live token streaming, tool-call chips, a model switcher, and a statusline showing 5-hour and weekly allowance and context usage. It can collapse to a draggable orb, resume the last conversation after a restart, and offers a Codex mode that switches the same window to the OpenAI Codex CLI. Settings are overridable through a per-machine config.json.
use_cases: ask Claude about what is on my screen
get help with an error dialog or GUI without copy-pasting
edit the open document or slide with an AI agent
translate or explain foreign-language text on screen
always-on-top floating AI assistant on Windows
summarize an open article or PDF
how_to_run: Install Windows 10/11, Python 3.10+, and the Claude Code CLI, then run claude auth login
Double-click setup.cmd (recommended) to install the CLI and Python packages
Launch with Start Claude Overlay.cmd, pythonw claude_overlay.py, or python claude_overlay.py for logs
notable: Captures every monitor separately and labels primary vs secondary so Claude can read each screen
Uses the existing claude CLI login through the Agent SDK; no API key or metered billing
Duplicate screenshots are not re-sent when the screen is unchanged
Optional Codex mode switch in the titlebar using the Codex CLI and its own login
Resume last conversation after restart, with reconnection into the same session
caveats: Requires separate claude CLI install and login, plus Python packages
Agent-driven document edits may be unreliable; the README advises checking important files
